basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 321- a stylish 3 Bedroom, 2 Bathroom home at 8200 Oceanview Village! This home boasts open kitchen with stainless steel appliances and extensive cabinetry. The kitchen, living, and dining areas are open concept - an ideal layout for hosting guests or enjoying the outlooks to the landscaped courtyard. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet, ensuite bathroom, and access to the large private patio. The other 2 bedrooms are well-sized and also includes spacious closets. Completing this unit are in-unit laundry, a coveted parking space and intercom system just next to H-Mart Shopping Center. Residents of Oceanview Village enjoy the convenience of H Mart for fresh produce and groceries, along with their food court which includes Daeho, Paris Baguette, and many additional eateries! This location provides easy access to the 280 freeway, proximity to Bart, Lake Merced, Stonestown Galleria and much more. Claim this urbanization and cozy home to yours!
